description: The same contract one breaking change later: `Session` gained a required `title`.

Two versions of one contract in one directory is the case the root barrel's namespace rule exists for. A plain `PipeRpc` would be one namespace naming two different `Session`s, so both of this contract's namespaces carry their version — and `pipe.vocab`'s, held at one version, carries none.
When the session began, in the shared spelling rather than a private restatement of it.

types.name: Session
description: A running session, as the rpc caller sees it — now with the title a listing renders.

fields.name: title
description: What a listing calls it. Required, which is the breaking change that made this a version 2.
